exercises.title: Place and review a market order
exercises.description: Place a demo MARKET BUY for any instrument and open its order details. Notice that it filled at the ask, not at the mid price.

exercises.title: Rest and cancel a limit order
exercises.description: Place a demo LIMIT BUY well below the current ask so that it rests OPEN, then cancel it and check that the reserved cash is released.

exercises.title: Protect a holding with a stop
exercises.description: On a demo holding, place a SELL STOP or SELL STOP-LIMIT below the current bid. It counts once the order is accepted (shares reserved); it does not need to trigger.

exercises.title: Size a position from a risk budget
exercises.description: Get a scenario, calculate the quantity that risks the stated amount, then place a demo BUY for exactly that quantity of the scenario's instrument within 7 days. Profit or loss is irrelevant.
